## Bundled font software

| Component / original authors | Applicable license | Local paths and required notices | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fraunces — The Fraunces Project Authors | SIL OFL 1.1 (`OFL-1.1`) | `fonts/Fraunces[SOFT,WONK,opsz,wght].ttf`; preserve [Fraunces-OFL.txt](fonts/Fraunces-OFL.txt) unchanged | [Fraunces](https://github.com/undercasetype/Fraunces) |
| Inter Tight — The Inter Project Authors | SIL OFL 1.1 (`OFL-1.1`) | `fonts/InterTight[wght].ttf`; preserve [InterTight-OFL.txt](fonts/InterTight-OFL.txt) unchanged | [Inter Tight](https://github.com/rsms/inter-tight) |

The existing font files are source-only under the standing no-self-hosted-font
constraint. This index does not approve their delivery or declare asset rights
cleared. The [provenance register](provenance/register.json) and
[brand governance](docs/brand-governance.md) retain their existing authority.
Logo outline provenance and all pending approval questions remain unresolved.
